sample.selection_rule: First evidence tranche selected before outcome construction; unsupported provider assets remain in the market panel and out of activity specifications.

H2.claim: Economic activity predicts value more strongly when an active burn or protocol-capture mechanism exists.
H2.interpretation: Fees, protocol revenue, and holder revenue remain separate. Chain-level BTC/ETH/BNB/ARB observations and application-level UNI/AAVE observations require scope indicators and within-scope sensitivity analysis before headline estimation.

H8.claim: Active and material multi-function assets command a valuation premium.
H8.breadth_rule: Withhold breadth unless all ten VA codes are verified for the asset-date.

time_rules.activity_lag: exact calendar t-1; gaps remain null
time_rules.forward_return: log price at exact t+7 minus log price at t; gaps remain null
time_rules.realized_volatility: annualized sample standard deviation of 30 consecutive daily log returns
time_rules.mechanism_state: latest evidenced effective event on or before t; no August-state backfill

estimation_gate: This pilot output is construction- and coverage-ready only. Freeze the draft and predeclare scope sensitivity, model, and standard-error choices before estimation.
